contexts.label: definition-galois-group: for a Galois extension E/F the group Aut(E/F) is the Galois group, denoted Gal(E/F)
the fixed field notation: for a group G acting on a field K by automorphisms, K^G = {x in K | sigma(x) = x for all sigma in G} is the fixed field
